fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header, or with Accept-Encoding: identity, and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that accepts gzip can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.
stability_check: First downloaded on 2026-09-25 at 12:25Z by the researcher and downloaded again at 13:06Z; the independent check downloaded it again at 13:14-13:18Z with Accept-Encoding: identity. Every download had the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded again for this packet at 2026-09-25T15:30Z (integration pass) with the same byte count and SHA-256.
provenance_note: Raw Internet Archive capture (id_ form) of the original page, captured at 2019-05-30T10:51:05Z (before the 7 September 2026 cutoff); that form replays the archived bytes unchanged and is used in place of the live page. Fetched without Accept-Encoding (curl without --compressed), the archive serves it uncompressed: the recorded byte count and SHA-256 are those of the uncompressed body. The response identity was confirmed by downloads at least 30 minutes apart (see stability_check). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Factual observations paraphrased with attribution; short quotations only. No photographs, seals, coats of arms, signatures or long speech text copied. No open license, portrait permission or likeness approval is asserted.
scope_note: Raw capture (30 May 2019) of the gov.za copy of the Presidency's media advisory, made on the day of issue. It concerns Ministers and Deputy Ministers only and never mentions a Deputy President.

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Presidency's advisory of 30 May 2019 says the swearing-in of the Ministers and Deputy Ministers will take place that day at 15h00 at the Sefako Makgatho Presidential Guest House, with Chief Justice Mogoeng Mogoeng presiding, and that the new members of the National Executive were appointed by President Ramaphosa on Wednesday 29 May 2019.

bounded_scope: Deputy President observations for CLAUDE-C01-21 only (role za_deputy_president in za_presidency). Announcements, stated intentions, appointments and their notices, oaths and their scheduling, stated assumptions, releases, resignations and their stated effect, Assembly-seat events and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder observations and any start or end are decided in the packet, not by any row. The President's roles (za_president_election, za_state_president) and the ANC's party office are excluded and no row feeds them.
